claims.claim: B has access to a means of telling the current time (e.g., a watch or phone)
claims.attribute: possession of time-keeping device or knowledge of current time
claims.adjudication_reason: The question 'What time do you have?' carries a presupposition that B has access to a means of telling the current time. Per the rules, definite possessives and presuppositions in questions may establish minimal information. The 'do you have' construction presupposes B possesses a time-telling device (watch, phone, etc.).
